summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Fleet Fuel Management System (SmartFuel). All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully operational with Google Maps integration, city autocomplete, route calculation, multi-stop fuel planning, theme switching, station management with ratings, and WhatsApp service order generation.

issues: 'For development purposes only' watermark displayed - expected behavior due to Google billing not enabled on API key

backend: POST /api/stations - creates new station with ratings
City search with short query returns empty
Route calculation Porto Alegre -> São Paulo (~1128km)
Route calculation with invalid city returns 400
Multi-stop fuel planning for long routes
frontend: Google Maps loads correctly with station markers
City autocomplete working (Porto Alegre, São Paulo, Recife)
Route calculation displays distance (1128km POA-SP, 3896km POA-Recife)
Route displayed on map following real roads
Fuel plan generated automatically for long routes
Fuel plan shows: stops count, total liters, total cost
Each stop shows: station name, distance, fuel amount, cost, reason
Theme selector with 6 themes (Escuro, Oceano, Floresta, Pôr do Sol, Meia-Noite, Claro)
Stations tab shows list with prices and ratings
Station editor with 4-category star ratings (Preço, Atendimento, Estacionamento, Segurança)
Parking type selector (Grátis, Pago, Com abastecimento mínimo)
Vehicle tab with editable fields (Litros Atuais, Consumo, Capacidade)
Service order generation with AI-generated message
Copy and WhatsApp share buttons functional

critical_code_review_comments: Google Maps API billing not enabled - shows 'For development purposes only' watermark (expected per agent context)
Google Places/Directions APIs fall back to local database and OSRM routing (working as designed)
Minor ESLint warnings in frontend (useCallback dependencies) - non-blocking
seed_data_creation: Seed stations automatically created via /api/seed-stations endpoint when no stations exist
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified working. Google Maps displays with development watermark (expected). City search uses local Brazilian cities database as fallback. Route calculation uses OSRM as fallback when Google Directions billing not enabled. Multi-stop fuel planning generates intelligent stops based on station ratings and prices. Service orders generate AI summaries using GPT-5.2.
